name: AWA — American Women's Association
summary: Long-running association for friendship, volunteering, and newcomer orientation — high ROI in the first 90 days for trailing partners.
body: AWA helps arriving partners and professionals plug into interest groups, volunteering, and social circles. In practice it is often broader than ‘Americans only’ — confirm current membership openness. Interest groups and volunteer days drive the value more than formal dinners. Frequently recommended alongside Bumble BFF and Meetup when Reddit newcomers ask how to meet women friends in male-heavy workplaces, and when trailing spouses want structure without a single Facebook megagroup. Pair with giving.sg for additional volunteer shifts and with ANZA / nationality groups for passport-specific calendars.
membershipNotes: Annual dues; interest groups and volunteering drive the value. Verify live requirements and openness for non-US members.
